title: "VanScoyoc_et_al_supplementary_results"
output: github_document
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse) #for manipulating data
library(here) #for setting reproducible working directory
library(cowplot) #for combining plot panels
```

```{r include = FALSE}
# Import data
data <- read_csv(here("data", "VanScoyoc_et_al_data.csv"))
head(data)
colnames(data)
```

```{r}
pred_prey <- data %>% 
                dplyr::select(pr_high_relative, py_high_relative) %>% 
                pivot_longer(1:2) %>% 
                separate(name, into = c("type"), sep = "_", remove = TRUE) %>% 
                group_by(type) %>% 
                summarise(med_val = median(value), sd = sd(value), n = n()) %>% 
                mutate(group = "Trophic position")

bodysize_tbl <- data %>% 
                  dplyr::select(pair_ID, predator_mass_category, prey_mass_category) %>% 
                  pivot_longer(2:3, names_to = "name", values_to = "mass_category") %>% 
                  separate(name, into = "name", sep = "_", remove = TRUE) %>% 
                  mutate(ids = paste0(pair_ID,name)) %>% 
                  dplyr::select(ids, type = mass_category)

bodysize <- data %>% 
                dplyr::select(pair_ID, pr_high_relative, py_high_relative) %>% 
                pivot_longer(2:3) %>% 
                separate(name, into = "name", sep = "_", remove = TRUE) %>% 
                mutate(ids = paste0(pair_ID,name)) %>% 
                left_join(bodysize_tbl, by = "ids", keep = FALSE) %>% 
                dplyr::select(-ids) %>% 
                group_by(type, name) %>% 
                summarise(med_val = median(value), sd = sd(value), n = n()) %>% 
                mutate(group = "Body mass")

trophic_level_tbl <- data %>% 
              dplyr::select(pair_ID, predator_trophic_level, prey_trophic_level) %>% 
              pivot_longer(2:3, names_to = "name", values_to = "trophic_level") %>% 
              separate(name, into = "name", sep = "_", remove = TRUE) %>% 
              mutate(ids = paste0(pair_ID,name)) %>% 
              dplyr::select(ids, type = trophic_level)
  
trophic_level <- data %>% 
                  dplyr::select(pair_ID, pr_high_relative, py_high_relative) %>% 
                  pivot_longer(2:3) %>% 
                  separate(name, into = "name", sep = "_", remove = TRUE) %>% 
                  mutate(ids = paste0(pair_ID,name)) %>% 
                  left_join(trophic_level_tbl, by = "ids", keep = FALSE) %>% 
                  dplyr::select(-ids) %>% 
                  group_by(type, name) %>% 
                  summarise(med_val = median(value), sd = sd(value), n = n()) %>% 
                  mutate(group = "Trophic level")

activity_tbl <- data %>% 
              dplyr::select(pair_ID, predator_circadian_rhythm, prey_circadian_rhythm) %>% 
              pivot_longer(2:3, names_to = "name", values_to = "circadian_rhythm") %>% 
              separate(name, into = "name", sep = "_", remove = TRUE) %>% 
              mutate(ids = paste0(pair_ID,name)) %>% 
              dplyr::select(ids, type = circadian_rhythm)
  
activity <- data %>% 
                  dplyr::select(pair_ID, pr_high_relative, py_high_relative) %>% 
                  pivot_longer(2:3) %>% 
                  separate(name, into = "name", sep = "_", remove = TRUE) %>% 
                  mutate(ids = paste0(pair_ID,name)) %>% 
                  left_join(activity_tbl, by = "ids", keep = FALSE) %>% 
                  dplyr::select(-ids) %>%
                  group_by(type, name) %>% 
                  summarise(med_val = median(value), sd = sd(value), n = n()) %>% 
                  mutate(group = "Circadian Rhythm")

hunting_mode <-data %>% 
                dplyr::select(type = predator_hunting_mode, pr_high_relative) %>% 
                group_by(type) %>% 
                summarise(med_val = median(pr_high_relative), 
                          sd = sd(pr_high_relative), n = n()) %>% 
                mutate(group = "Hunting mode")

predator_guild <- data %>% 
                    dplyr::select(type = predator_class, pr_high_relative) %>% 
                    group_by(type) %>% 
                    summarise(med_val = median(pr_high_relative), sd = sd(pr_high_relative), 
                              n = n()) %>%       
                    mutate(group = "Predator guild")

prey_order <- data %>% 
                dplyr::select(type = prey_order, py_high_relative) %>%
                group_by(type) %>% 
                summarise(med_val = median(py_high_relative), sd = sd(py_high_relative), n = n()) %>% 
                mutate(group = "Prey order")
```
```{r}
functional_traits <- rbind(pred_prey, prey_order, predator_guild, hunting_mode) %>% 
                        mutate(ci_high = med_val+sd, 
                               ci_low = med_val-sd, 
                               group = factor(group, levels = c("Trophic position", "Predator guild", 
                                                                "Hunting mode", "Prey order")),
                               n = paste0("n = ", n),
                               type = str_to_title(type),
                               type = factor(type, levels = c("Prey", "Predator", 
                                                                   "Mesocarnivore","Apex", 
                                                                   "Other", "Ungulate", "Rodent",
                                                                   "Primate","Lagomorph", "Marsupial",
                                                                   "Opportunistic","Cursorial","Ambush")))

fig_4a <- ggplot(functional_traits, aes(y = type, x = med_val, xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high)) +
            geom_vline(xintercept=0, color="grey60",linetype="dashed") +
            geom_point(color = "grey40") +
            geom_errorbarh(height = .1,color = "grey40") +
            scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-1,1),breaks=c(-1.5,-1,-0.5,0,.5,1))+
            facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free", space = "free") +
            theme_bw() +
            xlab("Median Shift in Activity") +
            ylab("") +
            theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
                  text=element_text(size=10, family="serif"), 
                    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                    panel.grid.major = element_blank()) +
            geom_text(aes(x = 0.75, label = n), family = "serif", size = 2.5, hjust = 0)
```

```{r}
functional_traits2 <- rbind(bodysize, trophic_level, activity) %>% 
                        mutate(ci_high = med_val+sd, 
                               ci_low = med_val-sd,
                               n = paste0("n = ", n),
                               group = factor(group, levels = c("Trophic level","Body mass", "Diel activity")),
                               type = factor(type, levels = c("> 100 kg","50-100 kg", "10-50 kg","< 10 kg",
                                                              "Nocturnal","Crepuscular","Diurnal",
                                                              "Herbivore","Omnivore", "Carnivore")))

fig_4b <- ggplot(functional_traits2, aes(y = type, x = med_val, 
                                          xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high, color = as.factor(name))) +
              geom_vline(xintercept=0, color="grey60",linetype="dashed") +
              geom_point(position=position_dodge(width= -.5)) +
              geom_errorbarh(height = .1, position=position_dodge(width=-.5)) +
              scale_color_manual(values = c("predator" = "#FFC30B","prey" = "#87CBBB")) +
              scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-1,1),breaks=c(-1.5,-1,-0.5,0,.5,1))+
              facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free", space = "free") +
              theme_bw() +
              xlab("Median Shift in Activity") +
              ylab("") +
              theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
                    text=element_text(size=10, family="serif"), 
                    legend.title = element_blank(), 
                    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#FFFFFF", color = "#3D3D3D"), 
                    legend.position = "bottom", 
                    legend.margin= margin(1,1,1,1), 
                    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = "transparent"), 
                    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                    panel.grid.major = element_blank()) +
              geom_text(aes(x = 0.75, label = n), position = position_dodge(width = -.7), 
                        family = "serif", size = 2.5, hjust = 0)
```

```{r}
fig4 <- plot_grid(fig_4a, fig_4b)

#ggsave("figure4.png", fig4, height = 5, width = 8, units = "in", dpi = 600)
```
